title: Charleston Pirate Tours
specs: Explore Charleston's oldest sections and waterfront
Children's tour includes free souvenirs like foam swords and pirate bandanas
Children must be accompanied by at least one paid adult.
Children under 3 are Free, but if you want the younger children to receive swords, treasure, and make flags, please purchase the Child 3-12 ticket.
Children's Treasure Hunt Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Private and group tours available, customizable to interests
includes: This tour even includes fun souvenirs: swords, treasure, maps, balloon parrots, and pirate flags!
blurb: Guests explore Charleston's oldest sections and waterfront with city-certified guides, learning about the Golden Age of Piracy, colonial history, the Revolution, and the Civil War. Tours include walking and motorized options, daytime and evening, with special children's treasure hunts featuring hands-on activities and souvenirs. Private, group, and live virtual tours are also available.
extraNote: This is a walking tour, so please dress appropriately for the weather and wear comfortable walking shoes. · Our tours go rain or shine, but if there is hazardous weather, we will cancel the tour. · If that happens, you have the options of rescheduling your tour (based your schedule and our availability) or a refund. · This is an outdoor activity, so please dress appropriately for the weather. · We go rain or shine, but for the children's tour, if it looks like there will be more than an occasional drizzle, we will cancel the tour. · If hazardous weather forces cancellation of the tour, you can reschedule (based on availability) or receive a refund.
